{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonar mapper''' was a device that emitted sonar pulses at regular intervals, mapping an area through echolocation. It had a maximum range of 100 meters. It could store 12 hours of readings, but it was not as detailed as a standard [[Sensor/Legends|sensor pack]]. It cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new and weighed 1 kilogram.
